cacheHint.zh-CN:
📁 完整输出已保存：{path}
如需调整搜索条件，直接 grep/read 该文件即可，无需重跑命令。
cacheHint.en-US:
📁 Full output saved to: {path}
To adjust the filter, grep/read the file directly; no need to re-run the command.

squashFromDescription.zh-CN: 要压缩的起始 user turn 索引，来自 session_log。
squashFromDescription.en-US: Starting user-turn index to squash, from session_log.

squashSummaryDescription.zh-CN: 要写入压缩后分支的完整结构化摘要。
squashSummaryDescription.en-US: The full structured summary to write to the squashed branch.

validateInputNotFound.zh-CN: 找不到 user message 索引 {from}。

validateInputIncomplete.zh-CN: user message {from} 尚未完成，不能压缩未完成的 turn。
validateInputIncomplete.en-US: User message {from} is not complete yet; cannot squash an unfinished turn.

validateOverlap.zh-CN: 索引 {from} 已落在已有后缀折叠范围内；当前 MVP 只允许从上一次折叠之后的新 user turn 开始。
validateOverlap.en-US: Index {from} is already inside an existing squash range; the current MVP only allows starting from a new user turn after the previous squash.

logDescription.zh-CN: 列出对话里你的每条消息（编号、内容、是否已回复），给 session_squash 挑压缩起点用。
logDescription.en-US: List your messages in the conversation (index, content, replied or not) so session_squash can pick a starting point.

logSnippet.zh-CN: 列出你的消息和可压缩起点
logSnippet.en-US: List your messages and squash starting points

squashDescription.zh-CN: 把从指定消息开始的对话压缩成传入的摘要，释放上下文空间。原对话不删，/tree 可找回。适用时机：一个任务做完、对话太长、准备开新任务。先用 session_log 看编号，再生成摘要并随本次调用提交。
squashDescription.en-US: Squash the conversation from a chosen message into the supplied summary to free up context. Nothing is deleted; use /tree to go back. Good times to use it: a task just finished, the conversation got long, or a new task is about to start. Run session_log first, then generate and submit the summary in this call.

guidelineBoundary.zh-CN: 只在任务边界压缩：一个任务已完整交付、准备开新任务时才调用；绝不在任务执行中途压缩，那会丢弃进行中的上下文，后续续做成本更高。
guidelineBoundary.en-US: Only squash at a task boundary: when one task is fully delivered and a new one is about to start. Never squash mid-task — it discards in-progress context and makes resuming more expensive.

guidelineIndex.zh-CN: 先调用 session_log 看消息编号，选已完成任务的第一条消息作为 from。
guidelineIndex.en-US: Call session_log first and use the first message of the finished task as from.

guidelineSummary.zh-CN: 调用 session_squash 时直接把完整结构化摘要放进 summary；不再有后续 finalize 步骤。
guidelineSummary.en-US: Pass the complete structured summary directly in session_squash.summary; there is no later finalize step.

guidelineLeaf.zh-CN: 压缩范围是 from 到对话末尾；from 之后聊的内容都会一起压进去。
guidelineLeaf.en-US: Everything from the chosen message to the latest one gets squashed, including anything said after.

guidelineContinue.zh-CN: 压缩完会自动继续干活；想停下来就直接打断。
guidelineContinue.en-US: The agent keeps working automatically after the squash; interrupt it if you want to pause.

pending.zh-CN: 已经有一个压缩请求在排队，等这轮说完就执行，别重复调用。
pending.en-US: A squash is already queued and will run when this turn ends; do not call again.

registered.zh-CN: 摘要已接收，将从第 {from} 条消息开始压缩。等这轮说完就执行，原对话不删。
registered.en-US: Summary received. Squashing from message {from} when this turn ends; the original conversation is kept.

squashSummaryEmpty.zh-CN: 摘要不能为空，请生成完整摘要后随 session_squash 一起提交。
squashSummaryEmpty.en-US: The summary cannot be empty; generate it and submit it with session_squash.

switched.zh-CN: 会话换了，排队中的压缩请求已取消。
switched.en-US: The session changed, so the queued squash was cancelled.

noInput.zh-CN: 找不到要压缩的起始消息，本次未执行。
noInput.en-US: Could not find the starting message; nothing was squashed.

noLeaf.zh-CN: 当前会话没有可压缩的内容。
noLeaf.en-US: There is nothing to squash in this session.

contextHint.zh-CN: 【提示】对话已经很长了（{tokens}）。如果你刚完成一个任务、准备开新任务，现在是压缩的好时机：先 session_log 再 session_squash。如果当前任务还在进行中，忽略这个提示——别在任务中途压缩。
contextHint.en-US: [Notice] The conversation is quite long now ({tokens}). If you just finished a task and are about to start a new one, this is a good time to squash: run session_log then session_squash. If you are still mid-task, ignore this — do not squash mid-task.

contextHintNotice.zh-CN: 对话已达 {tokens}，已提醒主 agent 在任务边界时考虑压缩。
contextHintNotice.en-US: Conversation reached {tokens}; the agent has been reminded to squash at a task boundary.

configInvalid.zh-CN: 配置 {path} 解析失败，已用默认阈值。
configInvalid.en-US: Failed to parse {path}; default thresholds are used.

configInvalidEnv.zh-CN: 环境变量 {env} 解析失败，已用默认阈值。
configInvalidEnv.en-US: Could not parse env var {env}; default thresholds are used.

configCommandDescription.zh-CN: 配置 pi-session-tools（如压缩阈值，支持 150k / 75% / 数字）
configCommandDescription.en-US: Configure pi-session-tools (e.g. squash thresholds; supports 150k / 75% / numbers)

configNoUi.zh-CN: 当前环境无交互 UI，无法用命令配置，请直接编辑配置文件。
configNoUi.en-US: No interactive UI available; edit the config file directly instead.

configPrompt.zh-CN:
输入新的压缩阈值（逗号分隔，支持 150k、75% 或数字；留空取消）：
当前：{current}
configPrompt.en-US:
Enter new squash thresholds (comma-separated; supports 150k, 75%, or numbers; leave empty to cancel):
Current: {current}

done.zh-CN: 压缩完成，已生成总结（原对话可用 /tree 找回）。
done.en-US: Squash complete; a summary was generated (use /tree to go back).
